purpose: Brand marks and canonical controls are REFERENCED, never redrawn. The plugin clones the node id listed here out of the open file and retints it; it never embeds path data for a logo. Where no node exists, the slot stays PENDING_OWNER and the plugin draws an empty, clearly-named placeholder instead of an approximation.
retint: A cloned asset has every solid fill and stroke in its subtree replaced with the `tint` token from the spec node, which is what makes it monochrome. Geometry is never modified beyond a uniform resize.

logo/spotify.source: ABOUT US > Main > Section 3: Social Media > Container > Spotify > Container > Vector
logo/spotify.note: Real Spotify mark, already in the file and already used on the About screen.

logo/yandex-music.source: ABOUT US > Main > Section 3: Social Media > Container > ЯМузыка > Container > Vector

logo/youtube-music.source: ABOUT US > Main > Section 3: Social Media > Container > YouTube > Container > Social Icons
logo/youtube-music.note: This is the YouTube mark, not the YouTube Music mark - they are different logos. Used here because it is the closest authentic asset in the file. NEEDS OWNER CONFIRMATION: either accept the YouTube mark for this row, or supply the YouTube Music mark and move this entry to CANONICAL_NODE.

logo/apple-music.note: No Apple Music mark exists anywhere in the Figma file. Not drawn, not downloaded. The owner needs to place the mark in the file and put its node ids here.

logo/lastfm.note: No Last.fm mark exists anywhere in the Figma file. Not drawn, not downloaded. Needed by the Settings row and the Last.fm screen.

control/find-track.source: COLLECTION > Main > Collection List > Track Item 1 > Container > Button
control/find-track.note: The canonical per-track 'find track' control: 40x40, 1px primary stroke, radius 9999, primary glyph inside. Reused verbatim by Broadcast History so there is one action pattern, not two.

avatar/m3.note: Predefined profile avatars, expanded to avatar/m3-01 … avatar/m3-16. The intent is the official Material 3 Design Kit avatar assets. The plugin cannot pull them from a library it has not been given ids for, so every cell is created as an editable named slot. The dry run also lists any local components in this file whose name looks like an avatar, so their ids can be pasted in without hunting.

howToSupply: 1. Place the mark in the Figma file, on either canonical page or the UI KIT page.
2. Right-click the node > Copy link, and take the node-id from the URL.
3. Put the dark-page and light-page ids in this file and set status to CANONICAL_NODE.
Until then the plugin creates an empty named slot and lists the asset as BLOCKED in its dry run.
